name: pull-down-cable-v-bar
title: Pull Down: Cable (V-Bar)
primer: This is an exercise for lats, biceps, and middle back strengthening.
steps: Attach a V-Bar to the pull down pulley of a cable machine.
Sitting upright with your abs drawn in, grasp the bar with a neutral grip, your palms facing in.
Pull the bar straight down to your upper chest.
Pause for a moment after touching the chest and then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
